name: Kerekegyháza (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Kerekegyháza (a blue shield with a red-clad figure, with a helm and red, yellow and blue mantling) above the name KEREKEGYHÁZA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kerekegyháza arms with helm and mantling
